_comment: Libretro cores RetroNest builds itself from pinned upstream commits (GPL corresponding source). Built by tools/cores/build_cores.sh; read by tools/cores_manifest.py and scripts/fetch-cores.ps1. Pinned 2026-11-13 to upstream HEAD.

bsnes._repoWhy: The libretro buildbot builds 'bsnes' from git.libretro.com/libretro/bsnes, mirrored on GitHub as libretro/bsnes-libretro (same HEAD); github.com/libretro/bsnes is a different, older-option-set tree. The buildbot binary we shipped embeds b51612a, which is this pin.

stella._ndkWhy: C++23 std::from_chars for floating point needs the r29 libc++ (libretro's CI pins NDK 29.0.14206865 for this core too).

melondsds._ndkWhy: libretro's android-cmake CI template swaps NDK r27d for 29.0.14206865; same here.
melondsds._embedsWhy: Release builds report only the version ('1.4.0'); no commit string is compiled in.
melondsds._depsWhy: FetchContent dependencies, keyed by melonDS DS's <NAME>_REPOSITORY_TAG cache variables. melonds-ds names melonDS by a branch (jtg/fix-uninitialized-opengl) and the rest by short hash or tag; each is resolved to the full SHA it fetched on 2026-11-13 and pinned here.
